authorization: User explicitly requested: 你可以自己修复一下数据的问题吧. This amends the prior prohibition on source-derived cleanup; original official files remain read-only.
supersedes: The strict no-repair attempt was BLOCKED before any frozen splits, NPZ or plans existed. Keep its artifacts as evidence; this is an explicit revision in the same experiment, not an undisclosed replacement.

repair.scope: All official Chair objects are inspected for grouping; only objects with both original and retained N in inclusive128..256 are eligible.
operations: Compute double-precision cross product of unchanged raw FP32 vertices. Remove only triangles with exactly zero cross-product norm.

Among remaining exact coincident unordered coordinate triangles, retain the face with the smallest original raw face ID; remove duplicate copies. Record original-index duplicates separately from coordinate duplicates.
Preserve all original vertices bitwise and their indices, including unused vertices, and preserve retained original face corner order. Retained faces are in ascending original face-ID order.
repair.small_nonzero_triangles: Retain, then reject object if any cross-product norm is <=1e-12 times squared original bbox maximum extent. Do not erase nonzero triangles under a tolerance.
repair.N: N means retained genuine source-face count for modeling; explicitly store original_N and retained-to-original IDs. Both original_N and N must stay128..256.
repair.surface_limit: Removing duplicate copies changes multiplicity; removing zero-area faces can remove line/point degeneracies. The union of positive-area triangles is preserved exactly. No perfect topology claim.

interface.rule: Every retained known/free crossing edge must have exactly2 retained incident faces AND exactly2 original raw incident faces, equal to the same retained faces. Reject candidate patch if any crossing fails; never reinterpret a raw abnormal crossing after cleanup.
interface.connectivity: Shared complete source-index edges; unchanged BFS/FPS rule on retained source triangles. No coordinate welding.

coordinates: Execute the same official preprocessing once on retained faces with all original raw vertices preserved; captured pre-OT and model x2 exact relation is unchanged. Whole-object bbox normalization therefore keeps original raw-vertex bounds. Add original_source_faces, retained_to_original_face, original_to_retained_face, repair_metadata_json. Existing dense source_face_ids index retained rows; explicit original_source_face_ids carry raw provenance.
grouping: Start with all prior conservative original-source groups, then union exact and normalized-rounded6 retained geometry across all local objects, then add the same bounded0.01 normalized vertex/centroid Hausdorff matches over original-range and historical objects after cleanup. No earlier group can be split apart. Historical exposure propagates through union.

plans: Unchanged1000 effective batches of8; train4C each, validation/test2C each; teacher8 p0 cases t=.5 at3 endpoints; test32 cases reused at3 models. Freeze identities only after full48 success.
